# Vendored libraries

- `crystal-battle`: <https://github.com/LinusU/pokemon-crystal-battle-engine>, commit `26828bbd5c00204469803d902864a21fa3cfbe9e` (Crystal Legacy's game data, battle rules and trainer parties, behind the `crystal-legacy` feature that `native/` enables), the `crates/crystal-battle` library without its tests. Local changes add serde serialization derives, add an interactive move-learning decision, and retain a full-party capture in the result (as a seventh result entry for the caller to send to storage). Astra also exposes the active move-learning slot, reports the recipient and progress of each experience award, and limits capture items to wild battles. The battle and move-summary screens share the native Hidden Power calculation. Upstream's level-100 rule (`Rules::max_level_takes_no_exp`) returns no participation experience inside Astra's split of the experience award. Fixed guardian encounters can disable spontaneous wild flight while retaining battle moves and the player’s Run command. A wild battle can start with a given `wBattleType` (`Options::battle_type`), so the Crystal adventures' scripted battles keep their forced shiny, held item and no-Roar rules. Normal wild battles use the original experience rules. A party member that both battled and holds an Exp. Share gets its two experience passes as one combined award, still raising happiness for each pass that would have levelled it up. The upstream checkout did not include a license file; its licensing should be confirmed before redistribution.
- `pokemon-synthesizer` 0.2.3: <https://github.com/LinusU/pokemon-synthesizer>, commit `66a0e01aa7d0554552a82f486b135af97f6c69ba`; upstream manifest declares MIT OR Apache-2.0. The upstream checkout did not include license text.
- `pokemon-sprite-compression` 0.1.2: <https://crates.io/crates/pokemon-sprite-compression/0.1.2>; upstream manifest declares MIT OR Apache-2.0. No ROMs or test fixtures are included.

The battle upstream still contains explicitly unported paths, including PP Up and contest-only mechanics. These are not covered by the smoke checks.
